one_line: Imperial Chola king consolidating Gangavadi and Kaveri frontier into a wider South Indian polity.

appearance.age_look: mid-40s, tall and broad-shouldered, a seasoned warrior-king with a disciplined build
appearance.face: oval face with strong jaw, medium-deep brown complexion, straight nose, neatly groomed moustache, a short trimmed beard along the jawline, calm yet intense eyes with a steady gaze, default expression composed and resolute with a hint of warmth
appearance.hair: thick black hair parted at the center and drawn back into a single mid-length knot at the back of the head; wears a simple yet regal Chola-style gold crown-band (mukuta) closely hugging the forehead with a central lotus motif and small side flaps over the temples
appearance.costume: upper body covered in a richly woven deep-red silk uttariya (shawl) draped over both shoulders and crossing the chest, pinned neatly with a small gold brooch at the right shoulder; beneath, a fitted, short-sleeved cotton tunic in muted cream; lower garment is a finely pleated ankle-length veshti/dhoti in off-white with a broad maroon and gold border, wrapped firmly and slightly flared at the bottom for movement; around his waist a sturdy leather and cloth war-belt with simple bronze fittings; he wears a broad gold neck torque with two smaller layered necklaces, modest gold armlets and bracelets, and plain gold stud earrings; feet in dark-brown leather sandals with simple straps; no fantastical armour, only a small segmented bronze chest-guard panel tied over the uttariya when in campaign mode
appearance.signature: a long, slightly curved iron sword with a simple crossguard, wrapped leather grip, and plain bronze pommel, always carried sheathed in a brown leather scabbard hanging from his left hip on a functional cloth-and-leather belt

ref_desc: Rajaraja Chola I is a tall, mid-40s brown-complexioned king with a moustache and neat jaw beard, black hair tied in a back knot under a simple gold crown-band, wearing a deep-red silk uttariya over a cream tunic and off-white gold-bordered veshti with modest jewellery, leather sandals, a small bronze chest-guard, and a sheathed curved iron sword at his left hip in warm red, off-white, gold and dark-brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Rajaraja Chola I as a dignified South Indian king in c.1004 CE: a tall, mid-40s man with medium-deep brown skin, oval face, strong jaw, straight nose, intense yet calm eyes, a neatly groomed moustache and short jawline beard, and thick black hair parted and tied into a single knot at the back. He wears a simple regal gold crown-band hugging his forehead with a central lotus motif, a rich deep-red silk uttariya draped over both shoulders and crossing his chest, pinned at the right shoulder, over a modest short-sleeved cream cotton tunic. His lower garment is an ankle-length off-white veshti/dhoti with a broad maroon and gold border, wrapped neatly and slightly flared at the bottom, held by a practical cloth-and-leather war-belt. Add a small segmented bronze chest-guard panel tied over the uttariya to show campaign readiness, along with a broad gold neck torque, two slimmer necklaces, modest gold armlets, bracelets and simple gold stud earrings. Put dark-brown leather sandals on his feet. His signature weapon, a long slightly curved iron sword with simple crossguard, leather-wrapped grip and plain bronze pommel, hangs sheathed in a brown leather scabbard from his left hip. Use a warm palette of deep red, off-white, gold, dark brown and muted cream, and show him in a neutral stance front view with slight angle view to clearly present his hair, face, garments and sword for consistent character reference.
